RATIONALE: This is the third functional form (product, signed product, now rank-sum) of the same wedge×liquidity pair already in the archive, and switching to an additive rank-sum actually removes the interaction the hypothesis claims ("combining... with"), making it a cosmetic re-specification rather than a new mechanism.

---CRITIQUE Balanced Unsupported Working-Capital Stress---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 2
RATIONALE: A rank-sum re-encoding of the archived "Cash-Constrained Unsupported Working Capital" product; the additive form is no longer a conditional/composite interaction but a simple average of two separately-tested stress proxies, so any improvement would be attributable to functional form rather than economic insight.

---CRITIQUE Balanced Tax-Loss Runway Stress---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 1
RATIONALE: Pure rank-sum of the two ingredients of the archived "Tax-Loss Operating Runway," which collapses to an equal-weighted average of a low-tax (low-profitability) proxy and a cash-to-cost liquidity proxy — no joint-distress state is preserved, contradicting the stated reasoning that the joint extreme matters.

---CRITIQUE Balanced Unfunded Cash-Loss Stress---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 2
RATIONALE: Yet another instance of the same mechanical MUL→SUMRANK substitution, here on the archived "Cumulative Unfunded Cash-Earnings Loss," and the diagnosis ("product compression") is asserted identically across four proposals without any signal-specific evidence.

---CRITIQUE Dual Operating Recovery Under Thin Runway---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: The economic idea (require margin-preserving, not just top-line, recovery) is a genuine refinement of the best archived signal, but MIN is applied to two raw trends on incomparable scales — revt/at trends are typically ~3x the magnitude of (revt-cogs)/at trends — so the minimum will almost always bind on the gross-profit trend and the signal degenerates to a near-duplicate of gross-profit-trend × thin runway; rank-standardize both legs before taking MIN.

---CRITIQUE Asymmetric Cost Compression Under Thin Runway---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: Sign logic is internally consistent and the downside-path asymmetry is a substantive (not cosmetic) upgrade over the archived cost-share-trend × runway signal, though the trend and the cumulative-positive-shock term are largely mechanically collinear, so the SUMRANK may add little beyond the trend alone.
